description: Practical thoughts on building, selling and keeping promises.

items.text: Your most unhappy customers are your greatest source of learning.
items.author: Bill Gates

translations.en: Your most unhappy customers are your greatest source of learning.
translations.hi: आपके सबसे असंतुष्ट ग्राहक सीखने का सबसे बड़ा स्रोत हैं।

items.summary_1line: Learn most from your unhappiest customers.
items.summary_2to3line: Complaints are free consulting. The people who care enough to be annoyed are telling you where the product truly breaks.
items.bodh_3to4line: Treat criticism as data rather than attack. The customer who complains has stayed engaged; the one who quietly leaves teaches you nothing. Build a habit of mining friction for insight.

items.text: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
items.author: Alan Kay

translations.en: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
translations.hi: भविष्य की भविष्यवाणी करने का सबसे अच्छा तरीका उसे गढ़ना है।

items.summary_1line: Don't forecast the future - build it.
items.summary_2to3line: Rather than guessing what will happen, create the thing you want to see. Action is a better oracle than prediction.
items.bodh_3to4line: Planning is useful, but it can become a substitute for doing. When the future is uncertain, the person who ships something gets to shape it. Bias toward building.

items.text: If you're not embarrassed by the first version of your product, you've launched too late.
items.author: Reid Hoffman

translations.en: If you're not embarrassed by the first version of your product, you've launched too late.
translations.hi: अगर आप अपने उत्पाद के पहले संस्करण से शर्मिंदा नहीं हैं, तो आपने बहुत देर से लॉन्च किया।

items.summary_2to3line: Waiting for polish is often just fear in disguise. A slightly embarrassing launch beats a perfect product that never ships.
items.bodh_3to4line: Standards matter, but so does contact with reality. The first version exists to teach you what version two should be. Perfectionism at the start is usually procrastination.

items.text: The value of an idea lies in the using of it.
items.author: Thomas Edison

translations.en: The value of an idea lies in the using of it.
translations.hi: विचार का मूल्य उसके उपयोग में है।

items.summary_1line: An idea is worth what you do with it.
items.summary_2to3line: Ideas are cheap and plentiful; execution is scarce. The worth of a thought is realised only when it is put to work.
items.bodh_3to4line: Keep a bias toward implementation. The distance between a clever idea and a working product is where most value is created or lost. Judge yourself by what you built, not what you imagined.

items.text: Do not be embarrassed by your failures; learn from them and start again.
items.author: Richard Branson

translations.en: Do not be embarrassed by your failures; learn from them and start again.
translations.hi: अपनी असफलताओं से शर्मिंदा न हों; उनसे सीखें और फिर शुरू करें।

items.summary_2to3line: Every serious builder fails repeatedly. The skill is to extract the lesson quickly and begin the next attempt without shame.
items.bodh_3to4line: Shame is expensive and teaches nothing. Separate the outcome from your worth: the venture failed, you did not. Take the lesson, keep the momentum.
